subject: Success definitions, exit gates & evidence plan for 6-week trial
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@medisys.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@carebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Trial acceptance criteria and evidence we need

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with a 6-week pilot focused on clinical note extraction (entities + relations) for a subset of clinics. Before we kick off, Procurement asked me to confirm the success criteria and the exact acceptance tests so they can clear budget and timeline.

High level asks from our side:
- Clear pass/fail criteria so we can sign off at the end of week 6
- List of evidence artifacts (logs, sample outputs, metrics dashboards) we should expect
- Any specific security/compliance evidence (audit logs, data residency confirmation)

I've attached the data spec and a short description of the sample dataset we'll use (trial-data-specs.xlsx). Can you send a compact MAP showing acceptance tests, owners, and dates? Procurement wants that on file.

Best,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Data Science, MediSys Health
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@medisys.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura@carebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial acceptance criteria and evidence we need

Hi Sam — thank you, and glad to hear you're ready. Attached is a concise acceptance & evidence plan (trial-evidence-plan.pdf) and below is the MAP outline we propose. This keeps signoff criteria concrete and limited to what Procurement needs.

Overview (6-week pilot)
- Objective: Validate clinical entity extraction and relation linking at production-like scale for 10 clinics (sample size ~5k notes).
- Owners: Redwood delivery (Ben) for infra/observability; Redwood SE (Karthik) for onboarding, MediSys data team for sample validation.
- Kickoff: 2027-05-20. Review: weekly syncs (weeks 1,3,5). Final signoff: week 6 review (2027-06-30) — note: exact calendar aligned below.

Acceptance tests (pass = all must be met)
1) Accuracy: Entity extraction F1 >= 0.86 on agreed test corpus (held-out 800 notes).
   - Evidence: evaluation report and per-entity confusion matrix (PDF + CSV).
2) Relation linking: precision >= 0.82 on the same held-out set.
   - Evidence: relation-level PR curve and sample correct/incorrect vignettes.
3) Latency & throughput: p95 response latency <= 450ms for single-note transform at target batch sizes; sustained throughput >= 12 qps with <2% error rate during 30-minute soak.
   - Evidence: traces, p95/p99 latency charts, throughput dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana links).
4) Operational reliability: no unplanned downtime > 10 minutes; incident log for any failures with root cause analysis (RCA).
   - Evidence: uptime reports, incident tickets.
5) Security/compliance: all trial data stored in US region; access limited to named RH team and MediSys personnel; audit logs enabled and retained for 90 days.
   - Evidence: KMS key confirmation, access control list dump, sample audit log entries.

Exit gates (fail-fast criteria during trial)
- If accuracy falls below F1 0.80 for >2 consecutive weekly evaluations, we pause and run a triage sprint.
- If p95 latency exceeds 750ms for >15 minutes under normal load, we engage performance remediation playbook.

Artifacts we will deliver at signoff
- Evaluation report (CSV, PDF) with per-entity metrics and sample output set
- Observability links and dashboards with exportable metrics snapshots
- SCM snapshot of model + config used (image tag) and rollout manifest
- Signed acceptance statement from MediSys

Next steps / owners
- Ben (delivery): infra setup + dashboards (by 2027-05-18)
- Karthik (SE): onboarding runbook and smoke tests (by 2027-05-19)
- Sam / MediSys: deliver sanitized sample and test corpus (by 2027-05-19)

If that looks good I can convert this into a one-page MAP PDF for Procurement sign-off.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@medisys.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura@carebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial acceptance criteria and evidence we need

Adding operational detail here — thanks Irene. A couple practical notes on instrumentation and the smoke suite so expectations are aligned:

Smoke & instrumentation (owner: Ben)
- Smoke tests: local run to validate schema + basic throughput. Scripts will exercise the Redwood API endpoints with the sanitized sample. (attachment: smoke-scripts.zip)
- Canonical observability exports: p50/p95/p99 latency, errors/second, token counts, model variant. We'll provide Grafana URLs and JSON snapshots for signoff evidence.
- Replay harness: deterministic replay of 1k notes for regression checks (will produce CSV with outputs for audit).

Operational checklist for the kickoff
- API credentials scoped to trial, ephemeral keys rotated weekly
- Data retention flag set to anonymize PII for logs during early weeks until final sign-off
- CI job to snapshot model image + config used for each release during trial

I will aim to have the smoke scripts and dashboard links by 2027-05-19. If we see any red flags in week 1 metrics (accuracy drift or a sustained latency increase), we'll triage immediately and present a remediation plan within 48 hours.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Minor additions from SE side — thanks all. Proposed mutual action items to add to the MAP (so Procurement sees owner-level commitments). I recommend we keep these timeboxed.

MAP items (action | owner | due)
- Confirm final test corpus and labeling guide | MediSys (Sam) | 2027-05-19
- Infra & dashboards live in US region | Ben | 2027-05-20 (before kickoff)
- Run initial smoke + performance soak (1 hour) | Redwood delivery | 2027-05-21
- First formal evaluation report (metrics + artifacts) | Redwood eval team | 2027-05-28
- Midpoint review (week 3) – walkthrough results + risks | All | 2027-06-09
- Final evaluation & signoff meeting | All | 2027-06-30

Fallback & credit policy (commercial note)
- If we fail hard on acceptance (accuracy < threshold) after remediation, we will provide a 2-week extension at no charge to collect additional evidence.
- Any scope changes that increase compute or storage beyond the agreed sample will be budgeted separately.

Request: Sam, can you confirm that Procurement can accept the above test artifacts (CSV evaluation exports, Grafana snapshots, RCA writeups)? If yes we'll package as a single MAP PDF for signature.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
